title: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Semi-Supervised Learning for Resource-Aware Smart City Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.27703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart-city applications often combine scarce labeled data with abundant unlabeled observations. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) exploits both labeled and unlabeled data to improve classification under limited supervision. This article presents MOEA-SSL, a multi-objective evolutionary approach for lightweight semi-supervised tabular classification that jointly optimizes predictive quality and feature usage. Experimental evaluation on three Smart City classification datasets, considering 1\%, 5\%, and 10\% labeled data, shows that MOEA-SSL achieves competitive predictive performance compared with established lightweight SSL methods while significantly reducing feature usage relative to EA-SSL in all evaluated conditions. The computed Pareto fronts also provide lower-feature-use alternatives with limited degradation in classification performance.

translated_title: 面向资源感知智慧城市分类的多目标进化半监督学习
translated_abstract: 智慧城市应用通常将稀缺的标注数据与大量的未标注观测数据相结合。半监督学习（SSL）能够同时利用标注数据和未标注数据，在有限监督条件下提升分类性能。本文提出了MOEA-SSL，这是一种面向轻量级半监督表格分类的多目标进化方法，可联合优化预测质量与特征使用量。在三个智慧城市分类数据集上，分别考虑1%、5%和10%标注数据比例的实验评估表明，MOEA-SSL与现有的成熟轻量级SSL方法相比取得了具有竞争力的预测性能，同时在所有评估条件下相对于EA-SSL显著降低了特征使用量。计算得到的帕累托前沿还提供了特征使用量更低、且分类性能仅有有限下降的替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出多目标进化半监督学习方法MOEA-SSL，在智慧城市表格分类任务中联合优化预测性能与特征使用量，在仅1%-10%标注数据的条件下取得了与现有轻量级方法相当的分类效果，并显著降低了特征使用量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MOEA-SSL, a multi-objective evolutionary semi-supervised learning method that jointly optimizes predictive performance and feature usage for smart city tabular classification, achieving competitive accuracy compared to established lightweight SSL methods while significantly reducing feature usage under 1%-10% labeled data conditions.
